children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test resistance at $7.38-1/4 per bushel, a break above which could lead to a gain into the  $7.47-1/2 to $7.53-1/4 range.
The fall from $7.62-1/2 could be well broken down into five small waves, a structure signalling the completion of a bigger wave c.
The completion was further indicated by the break above a falling trendline. The wave pattern indicates a target of $7.43-1/2, the peak of the wave iv.
A break below $7.30-1/2 may trigger a fall to $7.23. Such a fall will be classified as a pullback toward the trendline, unless it extends below $7.23.
On the daily chart, two hammers formed around support at $7.13-3/4 on September 14 and September 15, strongly suggesting a completion of the correction from $7.95.
